source_text: A 2021 meta-analysis of 13 studies involving heterosexual men concluded no association between medical male circumcision and increased risky behaviors, such as condomless sex (odds ratio 0.94, 95% CI 0.82–1.07) or multiple partners (OR 1.05, 95% CI 0.92–1.20). [112]
